acceptance_predicates.description: Development/mock comparison binds selected provider, model, agent, workload, executable, and experiment digest.
The generated plan completes comparison with deterministic development/mock responses.
Unavailable credentials and provider mismatch produce typed warning-only development diagnostics or fail closed for identity errors.
No credential value is emitted to state, logs, or receipts.

definition_of_done: Exact-head provider-bound comparison receipt is recorded.
Independent review, hosted checks, generated projections, and no-secret scan pass.

gates.description: Provider/model and experiment identities match across plan, run, and comparison.
Development authentication warnings remain non-blocking while identity errors fail closed.
